title: Select existing field-audit tests for a shared style change

rubric.text: Trace ResolvedGlassStyle consumers, comparison/reuse projections and the existing GlassReuseComparisonFieldsTest field inventory; include that structural audit alongside new fallback rendering tests in focused validation before push.

Verify the complete intended field/comparison contract rather than blindly incrementing a count until green; preserve fallback acceptance coverage and record selection rationale in the existing delivery record.
Keep mandatory exact-head CI and independent final review; do not use CI as affected-test discovery, duplicate CI locally without a reason, add a universal audit, or modify Haze.
